Package io.milvus.v2.service.vector.request.data

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    BaseVector
    The base interface for all vector data types that can be used in search and insert requests, such as float, binary, sparse float, int8, float16, and bfloat16 vectors.
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    BFloat16Vec
    A bfloat16 vector used in search and insert requests, stored in bfloat16 precision so that each two bytes represent one dimension of the vector.
    BinaryVec
    A binary vector used in search and insert requests, where each bit of the raw bytes represents one dimension of the vector.
    EmbeddedText
    An embedded text used for searching text stored in a struct field of a collection, where the text is embedded on the server side during the search.
    EmbeddingList
    A collection of vectors that is mainly used for searching vectors stored in a struct field.
    Float16Vec
    A float16 vector used in search and insert requests, stored in half-precision so that each two bytes represent one dimension of the vector.
    FloatVec
    A float vector used in search and insert requests, where each element represents one dimension of the vector.
    Int8Vec
    An int8 vector used in search and insert requests, where each byte represents one dimension of the vector.
    SparseFloatVec
    A sparse float vector used in search and insert requests, stored as a sorted map of dimension index to value so that only the non-zero dimensions need to be provided.
